info.name: MaintainX Rotation Schedules API
info.description:
REST API V1

Support: support@getmaintainx.com | https://www.getmaintainx.com/

This is the MaintainX REST API reference. It provides detailed documentation for endpoints, request parameters, response schemas, and error codes available.

For setup guides, authentication walkthroughs, how-tos, etc., see the Build With MaintainX guide.

What's in this reference:

Full endpoint listings across all MaintainX entities (Work Orders, Assets, Parts, Locations, Users, and more)

Request and response schemas with field-level detail

Query parameters, filters, and pagination behavior

Authentication requirements and error codes

Subscriptions and webhooks for event-driven integrations

Base URL: https://api.getmaintainx.com/v1

All requests must be authenticated with a Bearer token (see Settings > Integrations > API Keys to generate a key).

API access is available on Premium and Enterprise plans.

Contact Support:
 Name: Support
 Email: support@getmaintainx.com

request.description: Deletes a rotation schedule and unassigns every user currently assigned to it. This is a soft delete: the rotation stops being returned by the read endpoints and cannot be restored through the REST API. Deleting an already deleted rotation is a no-op. The default rotation cannot be deleted.

request.description: Updates a custom work rotation and, optionally, who is assigned to it. Changing `days` or `startDate` re-bases the cycle for every user currently assigned to the rotation. Adding users unassigns them from whatever rotation they are currently on, and removing them returns them to the organization default rotation. `isDefault` and `sourceTemplatePattern` are fixed at creation and cannot be changed here. The organization is resolved from `{id}`, so no `x-organization-id` header is required.
